review_candidates.description: Job Title: Senior Adversary Emulation Specialist Location: United Arab Emirates (Remote) Employment Type: Full-Time Work Arrangement: 100% Remote — Work From Home Level: Senior About the Role We are seeking a Senior Adversary Emulation Specialist to evaluate and strengthen organizational cybersecurity defenses by simulating the tactics, techniques, and procedures (TTPs) of sophisticated cyber adversaries. The role focuses on developing controlled attack scenarios based on real-world threat intelligence, assessing defensive capabilities, identifying security gaps, and improving detection and response effectiveness. The successful candidate will work closely with red teams, blue teams, threat intelligence analysts, and security engineering professionals to validate security controls and enhance organizational resilience. All activities will be conducted remotely within approved environments and explicitly authorized testing scopes. Key Responsibilities Design and lead controlled adversary emulation exercises based on relevant cyber threat intelligence. Research advanced persistent threats, cybercriminal groups, and emerging attack techniques to develop realistic simulation scenarios. Map adversary tactics, techniques, and procedures to the MITRE ATT&CK framework. Develop emulation plans that assess security controls across endpoints, networks, cloud environments, identity systems, and applications. Conduct authorized simulations of attack behaviors to evaluate organizational detection and response capabilities. Assess defensive visibility, security monitoring coverage, alert generation, and incident escalation procedures. Collaborate with security operations teams to validate detection rules and identify monitoring gaps. Evaluate endpoint detection and response, SIEM, XDR, identity security, and network defense capabilities. Develop controlled testing procedures and reusable simulation scripts within approved environments. Analyze exercise telemetry, security logs, and investigation records to determine whether simulated activities were detected and handled appropriately. Identify weaknesses in preventive controls, defensive configurations, and incident response workflows. Coordinate purple team exercises to improve collaboration between offensive and defensive security functions. Develop remediation recommendations based on observed control weaknesses and measurable testing outcomes. Conduct follow-up validation to confirm that security improvements effectively address identified gaps. Maintain detailed documentation of exercise objectives, authorization, scope, execution results, and technical findings. Prepare executive reports and technical assessments outlining adversary emulation results and organizational risk exposure. Mentor junior security professionals and promote continuous improvement in adversary emulation practices. Qualifications and Experience Bachelor's or master's degree in Cybersecurity, Computer Science, Information Technology, Digital Forensics, or a related field. Significant professional experience in adversary emulation, red teaming, penetration testing, threat intelligence, or security validation. Strong understanding of advanced cyberattack methodologies and real-world adversary behavior. Practical knowledge of the MITRE ATT&CK framework and threat-informed defense methodologies. Experience developing adversary emulation plans and controlled attack simulation scenarios. Familiarity with security testing frameworks and tools such as MITRE CALDERA, Atomic Red Team, Infection Monkey, or comparable platforms. Understanding of endpoint, network, cloud, identity, and application security architectures. Experience with SIEM, EDR, XDR, threat detection, and security monitoring technologies. Knowledge of common attack techniques involving credential access, lateral movement, persistence, privilege escalation, and command-and-control behavior. Ability to analyze security telemetry, event logs, and detection outcomes. Familiarity with scripting and automation using Python, PowerShell, Bash, or similar languages. Understanding of incident response, threat hunting, and security control assessment. Strong analytical, investigative, and technical problem-solving capabilities. Excellent technical writing and stakeholder communication skills. Ability to manage sensitive security projects independently in a fully remote environment. What We Offer 100% remote working arrangement from within the applicable employment jurisdiction. Competitive compensation based on experience and technical expertise. Opportunities to contribute to advanced cybersecurity and threat-informed defense initiatives. Professional development in adversary simulation, threat intelligence, and security validation. Collaboration with international teams across cybersecurity, engineering, and security operations. How to Apply Interested candidates should submit an updated CV highlighting their experience in adversary emulation, red team operations, MITRE ATT&CK, threat intelligence, security testing, and defensive control validation. Application Subject: Application – Senior Adversary Emulation Specialist (UAE Remote) Candidates should confirm applicable employment arrangements, residency requirements, and work authorization before accepting an offer. All adversary emulation, penetration testing, and security simulation activities must have documented authorization, clearly defined scope, and appropriate safeguards. Formal security certifications and regulated cybersecurity services must be provided by appropriately qualified and authorized professionals.

review_candidates.description: About Us Chevron is a leading multinational energy company with operations in over 180 countries. Founded in 1879, Chevron has a rich history of innovation and growth, making significant contributions to the global energy landscape. Chevron markets Caltex® fuels, lubricants and other petroleum products in the Philippines. Our network of service stations, terminals and sales offices forms the backbone of our presence in the Philippines. In March 2020, Chevron sold its 45% non-operated interest in the Malampaya natural gas field. This was the first natural gas development and largest industrial project in the Philippines. From the Philippines, we provide operational support for Chevron offices on five continents. The workforce supplies transactional, processing and consulting services in areas ranging from finance to information technology. Chevron operates through two subsidiaries in the Philippines. Our Downstream company is Chevron Philippines Inc. We also operate a business processes support organization through Chevron Holdings Inc. There are two Chevron companies operating in the Philippines: Chevron Holdings Incorporated (CHI) and Chevron Philippines Incorporated (CPI). CHI is a shared services center providing transactional, processing, and consulting services in the areas of finance and accounting, information technology, supply chain management, human resources, downstream customer service and marketing. Established in 1998, CHI serves Chevron affiliates in six continents around the world. Over the years, it has grown to be one of the leading members of the shared services industry in the Philippines. CHI has received various recognitions as a top employer: the 2022 Diversity Company of the Year; 2021 Asia’s Best Employer Brand Award; 2021 Global Best Employer Brand Award; 2020 HR Asia Best Companies to Work for in Asia; 2019 Circle of Excellence, Top Employer Category at Asia CEO Awards, and the 2018 Wellness Company of the Year at the same Asia CEO Awards. CPI markets the Caltex brand of top-quality fuels, lubricants, and petroleum products through a network of service stations, terminals and sales offices. At Chevron, we believe humanity can solve any challenge – including meeting the world’s energy needs of today, while advancing a cleaner energy tomorrow. About The Role We have an exciting opportunity for a Site Reliability Engineer . This role will be based in 6750 Building, Makati City. Responsibilities Include, But Are Not Limited To, The Following Use broad full-stack knowledge and experience for proactive incident prevention by baselining against expected service performance, process improvement from application of lessons learned, and utilization of data analytics to proactively identify problem areas and operational gaps. Effectively and efficiently lead product line agile teams in troubleshooting and resolving system problems, including analyzing application and critical system performance. Provide on-call operational support and serve as a technical resource during critical (P1) and major incidents supporting multiple technologies. Facilitate SRE technical assessments, identify gaps, and provide recommendations to product teams on SRE maturity journey plans based on Chevron’s SRE framework. Find opportunities to avoid future issues by improving logging and creating automated resolutions based on triggers. Develop automation scripts for repetitive tasks to eliminate toil / operations support activities. Oversee production environments by monitoring availability and maintaining a holistic view of system health. Measure and optimize system performance, continuously seeking innovation and improvement to meet customer needs. Align, collaborate, and build relationships with peers, company leadership, subject matter experts and users to improve knowledge of end-to-end DevOps / Site Reliability Engineering best practices. About You We know our greatest resource is the ingenuity, creativity and innovation of our people. Applications from motivated and talented individuals with a keen interest in the energy industry are encouraged. Knowledge, Skills, And Experience Hands-on experience as an IT professional with Computer Science/ Management Information Systems (MIS) degree or related field equivalent experience. Demonstrated experience in on-prem and cloud architecture, Azure cloud, Windows and Linux OS, performance monitoring & management, troubleshooting (application and database), change management, API integration, and process automation. Analytical, troubleshooting, RCA (Root Cause Analysis) or postmortem skillset; knowledgeable with ITSM processes, especially Incident Management. Strong facilitation skills and ability to summarize complex information into succinct messages for non-technical audiences, remaining calm under pressure. Knowledge or experience with KQL, CI/CD pipeline with Ansible, PowerShell, and Shell scripting. Knowledge in Agile (SAFe) PI Planning, value stream mapping, scrum ceremonies. Preferred Qualifications T-shaped/full stack infrastructure & software engineering skills to deliver end-to-end solution via best practices and team collaboration. Communication and Teamwork - Ability to communicate in a clear and concise manner, consider the views and concerns of others, achieve objectives through teamwork, and deliver consistently on commitments. Critical and Analytical Thinking skills - Ability to lead technical discussions, including Major Incident and problem resolution calls. Solve problems of a complex nature. Decipher and communicate issues and solutions to complex/advanced analytical problems. Apply ingenuity, creativity and innovative thinking to identify novel solutions to problems. Leverage knowledge and best practices of Site Reliability Engineering such as SLO, SLI, and SLA definitions, eliminating toil via automation, error budgets, emergency response (triage, postmortem, retrospective), demand forecast and cost-effective capacity planning to inspire others in supporting Chevron’s Agile/DevOps transformation. Preferred training/certifications: Microsoft Azure Administrator (AZ-104), Azure Developer Associate (AZ-204), DevOps Engineer Expert (AZ-400), Network (CCNA, JNCIA), Security (PCNSA, CISSP), Linux/Unix Administration. Everything we do at Chevron is guided by our values and our commitment to The Chevron Way (https://www.chevron.com/about/the-chevron-way). At the heart of The Chevron Way is our vision to be the global energy company most admired for its people, partnership, and performance. Participate in world-leading energy projects, advance your professional development and expand your career within an inclusive, collaborative and high-performing workplace. Benefits Competitive salary Allowances, medical and optical reimbursements Health care coverage for you and your eligible dependents Robust employee centered programs for health and wellness Time-off to promote healthy work-life balance or to care for your family Annual corporate incentive bonus when the company meets established goals Recognition & awards program Long-term savings plan Life insurance Career development opportunities to all employees through onboarding, training and development, mentoring, volunteering opportunities and employee networking groups Hybrid work model - work remotely from home several days a week At Chevron, we are committed to fostering diversity and inclusion at all levels of our company and at all stages of the employee experience. We constantly strive to attract, develop and retain diverse Filipino talent. Globally, Chevron Corporation has achieved a rating of 100 percent in the Human Rights Campaign Equality Index for the past 17 years. The Index ranks American companies based on their commitment to equality in the workplace. Connect With Us Facebook Instagram LinkedIn Twitter

review_candidates.title: Network Platform Development Engineer (Switch, SAI, NOS/SDK, Routing/Tunneling/Overlay protocols, L2/L3 Development, C, Linux Kernel, DPDK)
review_candidates.description: About Marvell Marvell’s semiconductor solutions are the essential building blocks of the data infrastructure that connects our world. Across enterprise, cloud and AI, and carrier architectures, our innovative technology is enabling new possibilities. At Marvell, you can affect the arc of individual lives, lift the trajectory of entire industries, and fuel the transformative potential of tomorrow. For those looking to make their mark on purposeful and enduring innovation, above and beyond fleeting trends, Marvell is a place to thrive, learn, and lead. Your Team, Your Impact Marvell is a leading provider of innovative technologies, including ultra-fast read channels, high-performance processors, leading edge transceivers, highly efficient analog designs, and powerful cryptographic engines. These solutions address all segments of the hard disk drive (HDD) and solid-state drive (SSD) electronics markets, providing complete solutions including controllers, product firmware, and reference board designs. Many of the same technologies have been utilized in Marvell system solutions products, powering PCs, servers, cloud, and enterprise systems. What You Can Expect Architect next-generation switching and DPU-based solutions tailored for enterprise and cloud-scale environments. Implement and optimize control plane and data plane functionalities for switch platforms. Advance Layer 2/3 networking capabilities including VLANs, VXLAN, L2GRE, MPLS, BGP, OSPF, and multicast for scalable, resilient infrastructure. Design high-performance switching fabrics with sophisticated packet processing pipelines, QoS, congestion control, and telemetry support. Develop and integrate robust security features such as 802.1X, MACsec, NAC, micro-segmentation, and threat detection mechanisms. Contribute to and influence open-source initiatives (e.g., SONiC, SAI, OVS, DPDK, ODP, Linux kernel) and help define future networking standards. Collaborate with hardware teams to bring up new Switch SoC platforms and ensure seamless hardware-software integration. Participate in code reviews, design discussions, and continuous integration processes. What We're Looking For Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, or a related field with 10+ years of experience. OR Master’s degree with 8+ years of relevant experience. Proficiency in C, C++, Python, and Lua scripting. Deep understanding of Ethernet switching, Layer 2/3 protocols, DPUs and networking standards. Strong hands-on experience with SONiC, SAI, Cumulus Linux, OVS, DPDK, ODP, and DPU technologies. Familiarity with ARM multicore SoC architecture and high-speed packet I/O. Solid grasp of networking constructs such as ACLs, LPM, EM, routing, MAC learning, QoS, bridging, and load balancing. Exposure to cloud networking, SDN, or network virtualization technologies. Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities. Excellent communication and collaboration skills, especially in distributed team environments. Proven ability to independently plan, execute, and deliver complex technical projects. A passion for continuous learning and thriving in fast-paced, innovation-driven settings. This role is eligible to participate in Marvell's bonus and equity plans, including a new hire equity grant and annual equity refreshers, ensuring you are rewarded for your contributions and remain invested in the company's long-term success. Additional Compensation And Benefit Elements With competitive compensation and great benefits, you will enjoy our workstyle within an environment of shared collaboration, transparency, and inclusivity. We’re dedicated to giving our people the tools and resources they need to succeed in doing work that matters, and to grow and develop with us. For additional information on what it’s like to work at Marvell, visit our Careers page. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability or protected veteran status. Interview Integrity To support fair and authentic hiring practices, candidates are not permitted to use AI tools (such as transcription apps, real-time answer generators like ChatGPT or Copilot, or automated note-taking bots) during interviews. These tools must not be used to record, assist with, or enhance responses in any way. Our interviews are designed to evaluate your individual experience, thought process, and communication skills in real time. Use of AI tools without prior instruction from the interviewer will result in disqualification from the hiring process. This position may require access to technology and/or software subject to U.S. export control laws and regulations, including the Export Administration Regulations (EAR). As such, applicants must be eligible to access export-controlled information as defined under applicable law. Marvell may be required to obtain export licensing approval from the U.S. Department of Commerce and/or the U.S. Department of State. Except for U.S. citizens, lawful permanent residents, or protected individuals as defined by 8 U.S.C. 1324b(a)(3), all applicants may be subject to an export license review process prior to employment.
